close_reason: added RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier behind #[cfg(feature=rsa)]; test passes with OpenSSL-generated RSA-2048 cert
description:
Implement RSA-PKCS1v15 with SHA-256 as a concrete SignatureVerifier backend in pkix-path, behind the rsa feature flag.

OID: sha256WithRSAEncryption = 1.2.840.113549.1.1.11

Implementation:
  - Extract RSA public key from SubjectPublicKeyInfoRef using rsa::RsaPublicKey::from_public_key_der() or spki::DecodePublicKey
  - Construct rsa::pkcs1v15::VerifyingKey<sha2::Sha256>
  - Verify signature bytes against message bytes (the DER TBSCertificate)
  - Return Ok(()) on success, Err(signature::Error::new()) on failure (per corrected return type from PKIX-q13)

Also handle sha384WithRSAEncryption (1.2.840.113549.1.1.12) and sha512WithRSAEncryption (1.2.840.113549.1.1.13) for completeness — same code path with different SHA variant.

Test vectors: use OpenSSL to generate RSA-signed certs and extract TBSCertificate + signature bytes. Never derive test vectors from the code under test. Commit as hex literals in the test module.
  openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -out cert.pem
  openssl x509 -in cert.pem -outform DER | xxd -p
title: pkix-path: RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA-256 SignatureVerifier backend
